---
title: "R reference"
---

Documentation generated from the Roxygen comments in `R/ros-schema-atlas.R`.

```{r, echo=FALSE, results="asis", message=FALSE}
env <- new.env(parent = globalenv())
sys.source("R/ros-schema-atlas.R", envir = env)
blocks <- roxygen2::parse_file("R/ros-schema-atlas.R", env = env)
topics <- roxygen2::roclet_process(roxygen2::rd_roclet(), blocks, env, getwd())
for (topic in topics) {
  rd <- tools::parse_Rd(textConnection(format(topic)))
  html <- tempfile(fileext = ".html")
  tools::Rd2HTML(rd, out = html, no_links = TRUE)
  lines <- readLines(html, warn = FALSE)
  body_start <- grep("<body", lines)[1L]
  body_end <- grep("</body>", lines)[1L]
  cat(lines[seq.int(body_start + 1L, body_end - 1L)], sep = "\n")
  unlink(html)
}
```
